title: Integrated GPU Core for Mamba-3
abstract: arXiv:2611.20409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mamba-3, the latest Mamba state-space model (SSM), enables efficient long-context modeling, matching Mamba-2 perplexity with half the state size and increasing decoding arithmetic intensity. However, its multi-input multi-output (MIMO) computation, exponential-trapezoidal discretization, and rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) introduce dense, element-wise, and sequential operations. Despite kernel fusion, conventional GPUs execute these operations inefficiently. Our characterization of Mamba-3 hybrid models reveals numerous kernel launches, substantial data movement, and increased register pressure that reduces warp occupancy and memory-latency hiding.   We propose RescuCore, a specialized GPU execution unit for Mamba-3 inference that retains other hybrid model layers on existing GPU resources. translated_title: 面向 Mamba-3 的集成式 GPU 核心单元
translated_abstract: Mamba-3 是最新的 Mamba 状态空间模型（SSM），能够实现高效的长上下文建模，在状态规模减半的情况下达到与 Mamba-2 相同的困惑度，并提高了解码阶段的算术强度。然而，其多输入多输出（MIMO）计算、指数梯形离散化以及旋转位置编码引入了密集的、逐元素的以及顺序性的操作。尽管采用了内核融合技术，传统 GPU 执行这些操作的效率仍然低下。我们对 Mamba-3 混合模型的特征分析揭示了大量的内核启动、显著的数据搬运以及增加的寄存器压力，这些因素降低了线程束占用率和内存延迟隐藏能力。我们提出了 RescuCore——一个专用于 Mamba-3 推理的 GPU 执行单元，同时将混合模型中的其他层保留在现有 GPU 资源上执行。RescuCore 与 CUDA 核心和 Tensor 核心一起集成在每个流式多处理器（SM）的子分区中，并共享寄存器文件。
tldr: 本文提出了 RescuCore，一种与 CUDA 核心和 Tensor 核心共同集成在每个 SM 子分区内、专为 Mamba-3 推理设计的专用 GPU 执行单元，以解决传统 GPU 执行 Mamba-3 密集、逐元素和顺序性操作时效率低下的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RescuCore, a specialized GPU execution unit integrated alongside CUDA Cores and Tensor Cores within each SM sub-partition, designed to efficiently accelerate Mamba-3 inference by overcoming the inefficiencies of conventional GPUs in handling its dense, element-wise, and sequential operations.
